dataPaths.containsDocroot: A data path cannot be or contain the document root ({{docroot}}/): the whole site would become data.
dataPaths.deleteConfirm: Remove the data path {{path}}/? From the next publication it will come from the release again (read only). The files already in /data are kept.
dataPaths.empty: No data path: the whole site is read only.
dataPaths.explain: The code is read only. Data paths are the only writable folders: in the release they point to /data/{{slug}}/<path>, where the application writes (uploads, caches…). PHP is never executed there.

extensions.none: No extension: nothing will be served.
extensions.phpRefused: Refused: {{exts}}. PHP-like extensions can never be allowed in a data path.
extensions.required: A typed path needs at least one extension.

dataPaths.nextPublication: Changes take effect at the next publication.
dataPaths.noProfile: Choose an application profile in the Overview tab first.
dataPaths.pathHint: Relative to the root of the release (not to the document root).
dataPaths.pathImmutable: The path cannot be changed: delete and add it again.
dataPaths.pathInvalid: Invalid path: relative, segments of letters, digits and . _ @ + -, without "..".

policy.ephemeralHint: Emptied at each publication (caches, temporary files).
policy.persistentHint: Kept across publications (uploads, user content). Scripts are never executed there.
policy.typedHint: Persistent, but only the listed file extensions are served.

actions.approveConfirm: Approve release #{{number}}? It will be published right away.
actions.rejectMessage: The release will never be published. Reason (optional, kept in its log):
actions.rejectReasonTooLong: The reason is limited to {{max}} characters.
actions.rollbackConfirm: Put release #{{number}} back online? The switch is instant; if its health check fails, the current release is kept.

diff.noPatch: No textual change to show (empty file, mode or rename only).
diff.patchTruncated: Patch truncated: the file has too many changes to be shown in full.
diff.title: Changes

releases.empty: No release yet: upload the site to the staging folder, then publish.
releases.explain: Each publication freezes the staging folder into an immutable release. The current one is served read-only; earlier ones can be restored instantly.
releases.onDiskNo: no (pruned, rebuilt from git on restore)

publish.explain: The current content of /staging/{{slug}}/ becomes a new immutable release, then goes live once its health check passes.
publish.needsApproval: This site publishes with approval: the release will wait for an approval before going live.
publish.title: Publish {{name}}

catalog.explain: The code does not change: the same release is served by another engine or PHP version. Pick a base to see the checks before switching.
catalog.title: Change base

groups.apacheHint: Honours .htaccess files: the usual choice for WordPress, PrestaShop, Joomla.
groups.nginxHint: Faster, but ignores .htaccess files: rewrites go in the custom nginx rules.
groups.staticHint: HTML, CSS, JS and media only: PHP is never executed.

runtime.noContainer: No container yet (the site is being provisioned or is stopped).
runtime.notInPlanError: This base is not allowed by the plan of the account.

preview.explain: The candidate base serves the SAME current release on a private URL. Production is untouched until you promote it.
preview.promoteConfirm: Make {{base}} the base of the site? Production traffic switches to it and the old container is removed.
preview.title: Preview (blue/green)

runtime.restartConfirm: Restart the containers of the site? Visitors may get errors for a few seconds.

secondary.explain: A secondary runtime serves a path prefix of the SAME release with another engine (e.g. /legacy/ on PHP 7.4). Attach it to a prefix in the Routes tab or on the Domains page.
secondary.note: The longest matching prefix wins; the primary runtime serves everything else.
secondary.title: Secondary runtimes

switch.directHint: The production container is recreated on the new base: a short interruption, then the health check.
switch.previewHint: Starts the new base next to production on a private preview URL; promote it once checked.
switch.title: Change base

runtime.unmaintainedHint: This PHP branch no longer receives security fixes.

warnings.htaccessIgnored: nginx ignores .htaccess files: their rewrite and access rules will no longer apply (move them to the custom nginx rules).
warnings.imageMissing: The image of this base is not on the node yet: it will be downloaded (the switch fails if it cannot be).
warnings.phpDowngrade: Older PHP version than the current one: the application may use features it lacks.
warnings.phpMajorChange: Major PHP version change: check the compatibility of the application and its extensions (a preview is recommended).
warnings.staticBaseWithPhp: The static base never executes PHP, but the release contains PHP files.
warnings.unmaintainedRuntime: This PHP branch no longer receives security fixes.

siteRoutes.basePathNote: A sub-site must know where it lives: the base path of this site is {{basePath}} (Overview tab).
siteRoutes.deleteConfirm: Remove the route {{route}}? This address will no longer serve the site.
siteRoutes.empty: No domain points to this site yet.
siteRoutes.explain: A route sends a domain + path prefix to this site. When several prefixes match a request, the longest one wins.
siteRoutes.noDomain: This account has no domain yet.
siteRoutes.prefixInvalid: Invalid prefix: "/" or a path such as /shop/.

actions.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its containers, releases and routes are removed, as well as /staging/{{slug}}/ and /data/{{slug}}/. This cannot be undone.
actions.stopConfirm: Stop "{{name}}"? Its containers are stopped and visitors get an error page until it is started again.

create.applyDataPaths: Create the data paths of this profile
create.applyDataPathsHint: Writable folders kept outside the immutable code (uploads, caches…).
create.noAccount: No hosting account where you may create a site.
create.noDataPaths: This profile needs no data path.
create.slugHint: Name of the SFTP folder of the site (/staging/<identifier>/ and /data/<identifier>/). It can never be changed.
create.slugInvalid: Invalid identifier: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, 40 characters max.
create.title: New site

detect.applied_one: Profile applied ({{count}} data path in total)
detect.applied_other: Profile applied ({{count}} data paths in total)
detect.explain: Looks for well-known files in the staging folder to recognise the application and suggest its base and data paths.
detect.none: No known application found in the staging folder.
detect.title: Application detection

errors.accountDeleting: The hosting account is being deleted.
errors.backendUnavailable: The container engine or the host daemon is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
errors.baseNotAllowed: This base is not allowed by the account's plan.
errors.dataPathForbidden: This path cannot be a data path (segments starting with a dot, php.ini and web.config are refused, and it may not contain the document root).
errors.dataPathLimit: A site has at most 64 data paths.
errors.dataPathOverlap: This path overlaps an existing data path.
errors.docrootInDataPath: The document root cannot be inside a data path.
errors.envelopeExceeded: The workspace's resource envelope would be exceeded.
errors.extensionsRequired: A typed data path needs at least one allowed extension.
errors.invalidCustomNginx: Invalid custom nginx rules (16 KiB max, no NUL character).
errors.invalidPhpSettings: PHP settings out of the allowed ranges (memory_limit is also capped by the plan's memory).
errors.noPreview: This site has no preview running.
errors.notFound: This item does not exist anymore or is not visible to you.
errors.notImplemented: This feature is not available on this server yet.
errors.planLimit: The account's plan limit is reached.
errors.publishInProgress: A publication is already running for this site.
errors.releaseIsCurrent: This release is already the current one.
errors.releaseNotAwaitingApproval: This release is no longer awaiting approval.
errors.releaseNotReady: This release is not published (or not committed yet).
errors.releaseRebuildFailed: The live release could not be rebuilt with the new data paths: nothing was changed.
errors.releaseSuperseded: A newer release has already been published; this one can no longer be approved.
errors.rollbackHealthcheckFailed: The restored release failed its health check: the previous one was kept.
errors.routeTaken: This domain already has a route on this prefix.
errors.runtimeInUse: This runtime still serves routes: detach them first.
errors.runtimeMismatch: This runtime does not belong to the site.
errors.runtimePrefixLimit: A runtime serves at most 64 path prefixes.
errors.runtimeSwitchFailed: The runtime change failed: the previous runtime was restored (details for administrators in the logs).
errors.runtimeSwitchNotRestored: The runtime change failed and the previous runtime could not be restored: the site may be down, contact an administrator.
errors.slugTaken: This identifier is already used by another site of the account.
errors.stagingEmpty: The staging folder is empty: there is nothing to publish.

files.data: The writable data of the site (uploads, caches…), one folder per data path. Changes here are live immediately, but PHP is never executed from it.
files.staging: The code of the site. Upload it here: nothing is live until it is published as a release (automatically or with the "Publish" button). The live code can never be modified in place.

form.basePathHint: For a sub-site served under a prefix (e.g. /blog/): the path the application expects. "/" otherwise.
form.debounceInvalid: The delay must be between 5 and 3600 seconds.
form.docrootHint: Folder of the release served by the web server, relative to its root (empty = the root; "public" for Laravel).
form.docrootInDataPath: The document root cannot be inside the data path {{path}}/.
form.healthcheckHint: Requested after each publication: an answer below 500 validates the release, otherwise the previous one is restored.
form.healthcheckInvalid: The health check path must start with "/".
form.title: Settings

nginx.note: Included in the server block of the site container only (never in the shared edge). Invalid rules are ignored at start-up and reported in the container log.
nginx.title: Custom nginx rules

sites.notFound: This site does not exist or is not visible to you.

php.cannotClear: {{field}}: a saved value cannot be emptied, enter a value.
php.postBelowUpload: {{post}} must be greater than or equal to {{upload}}.
php.title: PHP settings

publishMode.approvalHint: Every release waits for the approval of a user allowed to approve before going live.
publishMode.autoHint: A release is published automatically once uploads to the staging folder have stopped for the delay below.
publishMode.manualHint: Nothing is published until someone clicks "Publish" (or calls the API).

warnings.stagingMissing: The staging folder does not exist yet.

sites.subtitle: Immutable code, published from the SFTP staging folder.
sites.title: Sites
